payload.name: Banner Blindness
payload.fact: Internet users often avoid looking at banner advertisements, a phenomenon known as banner blindness.

provenance.title: Is Banner Blindness Genuine? Eye Tracking Internet Text Advertising
provenance.quote_or_locus: several studies suggested that Internet users ‘avoid’ looking at ads (what is often referred to as the banner blindness phenomena

provenance.title: Text Advertising Blindness: The New Banner Blindness?
provenance.quote_or_locus: Banner blindness, the phenomenon of website users actively ignoring web banners, was first reported in the late 1990s

provenance.title: The Impact of Advertising Location and User Task on the Emergence of Banner Ad Blindness: An Eye-Tracking Study
provenance.quote_or_locus: Banner blindness is strongest for advertising banners on the right side of the page and for goal-directed tasks
